nodes.label: GLUE: Global Library Unified Exporter
nodes.rationale: Local-first web app for DJs: builds a music collection from folders and DJ-app libraries (Rekordbox, Engine DJ, Traktor, Apple Music), analyses quality / BPM / key in the background, manages playlists, shows and sessions, finds duplicates, and exports back to Rekordbox and Engine DJ.

nodes.label: Speklone: spectral forensics predecessor
nodes.rationale: Spectral forensics: 'is this hi-res actually hi-res?' Original app; became GLUE's per-track Inspector and 'Analyze a file' mode.

nodes.label: GLUE Home: Tauri 2 tray app and library engine
nodes.rationale: When it runs, it is the library's engine and the website on that computer is its screen (ADR 0104). Handles file access, analysis, streaming to other devices, and cloud sync.

nodes.label: Vault: source of truth for the project
nodes.rationale: Project's memory: what GLUE is, what it does, why it's built the way it is, and what comes next. Contains SYSTEM.md, features, ADRs, research, product docs, logs and changelogs.

nodes.label: graphify: code map of code and vault
nodes.rationale: ADR 0127, 0128: tree-sitter maps files, symbols, imports, calls, SQL migrations and vault (ADRs, features, articles). Built per computer, published for every push to main on branch graphify. Used with affected/explain/path commands, never query.
